description.zh-CN: 在岛上加一个页面，用一个圆环画出今天的待办完成了多少，并列出接下来的几条；收起条上也有一个小环和「完成数/总数」。待办一变就跟着动。页面是插件自己写的 HTML（自定义界面），只能和插件进程通信，不能联网。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Adds an island page with a ring showing how much of today's todos is done and the next few to do, plus a small ring with done/total on the collapsed bar; both move as soon as todos change. The page is the plugin's own HTML (custom UI) that can only talk to the plugin process and cannot go online. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.
